description.en-US: One allowed value. A template narrows a global attribute to a subset: Color may be Black and White here while another template allows Red and Blue.

What choosing this value adds to the template's base sales price. Signed: XL may add 20,000 while a plain colour subtracts. Summed across a variant's chosen values to give its effective_base_sales_price (BR-PRICE-VARIANT-001).

It lives HERE, on Template × Attribute × Value, and not on the attribute value itself — which is why inventory_product_attribute_value.price_extra is no longer authoritative. The same value surcharges differently on different products: XL on a t-shirt is not XL on a tent. A single global number cannot express that, and BR-PRICE-VARIANT-002 forbids treating it as though it could.

Sales pricing only. It must never reach a cost calculation (BR-PRICE-VARIANT-008): a colour that sells for more does not thereby cost more, and adding it to cost would silently inflate every margin computed from it.
